webhook.description: Configure this webhook URL in Squarespace under: Settings > Advanced > Code Injection or use Squarespace's Zapier/Make integration
notes: In Make.com, create a new scenario with 'Webhooks > Custom Webhook' as the trigger
Copy the generated webhook URL and paste it into Squarespace
Alternatively, use Make.com's native Squarespace module if available
Test with a sample submission to map all form fields

squarespace_setup_steps: 1. Go to your Squarespace site editor
2. Navigate to the page where you want the form (e.g., /get-started)
4. Configure all fields as specified above
5. Under Form Settings > Storage, select 'Google Sheets' or configure webhook
6. Under Advanced, add the Make.com webhook URL for real-time processing
7. Style the form to match your brand
